id: title:jurajmajerik:log freeze and unfreeze exposure in history

review.posthog_relevance: Adds audit trail entries to the Experiment History tab for exposure freeze and unfreeze actions, supporting user visibility and operational accountability.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates the implementation of activity logging for exposure freeze and unfreeze operations, including the backend calls and corresponding tests. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in observability and auditability for the Experiment feature.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the freeze/unfreeze operations or the complete ActivityLog model, so the full behavior and potential edge cases are not demonstrated. The benefit is limited to the addition of the logging mechanism rather than the complete workflow.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the freeze/unfreeze operations, the complete ActivityLog model, or the complete experiment service.
